summary: Immuron Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting an ASX announcement on July 6, 2026, titled IMM-529 CDI Partnering Update. The announcement states that Immuron engaged Pullan Consulting to assist in securing a strategic partnership for its IMM-529 (Clostridioides difficile infection) program. No specific terms such as stake, price, value, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine business development update, not a definitive transaction. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of a partnering strategy, constituting a standard current report. No special-situation category applies.
